name: Förderung von Uferrückbauten an Oö. Seen
summary: Funding for planning, construction and ecological site supervision when hard shoreline structures on Upper Austrian lakes are removed to restore natural banks, mainly in protected areas. Funding covers up to 30, 50 or 70 percent by improvement.
reporting: Abrechnung und Einreichung der Rechnungen bei der Förderstelle

eligibility.rule: The dismantling is not required by a permit
The project is in a protected area, except in justified individual cases outside it
The project furthers the conservation purpose of the protected area

documents: Project location: property number and cadastral municipality
